title: What I Wore & Did in LA | April 2019
description:
Hey guys!!! I hope you’re all well! I’ve done a super quick little travel vlog from Los angeles from my trip (April 2019) I hope you enjoy it! We visited lots of super instagrammable spots in LA so if you’re after some good photo spots whilst you’re there then hopefully this will help! Also if you want some spring outfit ideas then I shared everything I wore and you can find all info if you expand the description below!

Subscribe for weekly fashion videos!
Check out my instagram for daily outfit posts! http://www.instagram.com/sineadcrowe 

Kimpton La Peer Hotel* : https://www.lapeerhotel.com/
*2 nights of our 5 were free of charge and the other 3 were at a discounted media rate
